summary.en: The name rises out of the accent field on the drop, its width jumping once a beat, two labels under it, then a playhead with the dot runs under it.
summary.zh: 名字在 drop 上从强调色满底里升起，宽度每拍跳一次，下方两条标签，随后一条带墨点的播放头从下面划过。

fits: The name on the first drop of a launch film.
notFor: a long name (it must fit at every width); a second name.

intent.en: The name breathes with the music: the drop lands it, the bar shapes it, and the dot underlines it.
intent.zh: 名字跟着音乐呼吸：drop 让它落下，小节塑造它，墨点在下面画线。

content.en: A name (one word, ≤ 10 chars) and one or two labels (≤ 20 chars).
content.zh: 一个名字（一个词，≤ 4 字）和一两条标签（每条 ≤ 8 字）。

fits.zh: 发布片第一次 drop 上的名字。

notFor.zh: 长名字（每种宽度都要放得下）；第二个名字。

en: The name is fitted at its widest width, so every jump stays inside the margins.
zh: 名字按最宽的宽度定字号，所以每次跳宽都不出边距。
